_comment: The confirmed panel for this repository's deployment. default_panel() in
_model_panel_core.py ships placeholder GPT ids and an older Opus id on
purpose, and points the owner at --panel-config to name real ones. This
Both tiers are references because these are the only two models the owner
runs; there is no cheaper tier in production whose degradation would be
actionable. Add probe tiers here if that changes.
Provider is copilot-cli, which needs no API key and reaches both ids
through the operator's existing Copilot authentication. Model ids were
verified live against the CLI, not copied from a catalog.
